rationale: Browser-capture lowering scales a node's border widths, corner radii and shadow lengths by the per-axis scale its post-transform box already carries from its own and its ancestors' computed transforms (left/right borders by sx, top/bottom by sy, shadow offsets per axis, radii and blur only under a uniform scale), and refuses and counts what one factor per axis cannot carry. The IR contract and box meaning are unchanged; only lengths drawn inside the captured box move. A new captured fixture (browser-capture-paint-scale) and its test are added. Chromium stays the only oracle and Skia/Dawn the renderer; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
